info.name: Vacate API
info.description: Postman requests for all documented Vacate API operations. Import this collection and run the local API with DevelopmentAuthentication__Enabled=true and SeedData__Enabled=true. Sign in first. Requests use fictional development accounts and seeded sample GUIDs only. Run create requests before examples that use their captured IDs; sign out and soft-delete requests are ordered last. Inspect cleanup URLs before sending. Do not use the development credentials or fixture data in production. See docs/contracts/openapi.yaml.
